question: Should generic tool-progress intent become a supported public reply-payload plugin-SDK contract?
rationale: The patch adds public symbols and a cross-plugin metadata convention whose supported payload shapes and long-term compatibility are not established by maintainer discussion.

options.title: Approve generic SDK intent
options.body: Keep the closed generic progress kind, define its supported payload shape, and let channels map it to transport-native progress presentation.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Use a bundled or internal reply-runtime seam for Codex-to-Slack coordination without creating third-party API.

options.title: Defer progress suppression
options.body: Pause the cross-plugin behavior until a broader portable status-presentation contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve generic SDK intent
recommendation.body: Keep the closed generic progress kind, define its supported payload shape, and let channels map it to transport-native progress presentation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans both the Slack rendering boundary and Codex projector surface involved in this API choice.
